description: Missing proof obligations and broken traceability. (1) REQ-013 (lefthook install across all four repos) has NO PROP and NO bead. (2) NFR-002 (zero false-negative ACTIVE) -- the most important safety property -- has no dedicated property/adversarial test; prose only. (3) Marker inconsistency: REQ-012 requires a 'MUTATING' marker but PROP-030 only asserts marker='DRY-RUN'; no PROP verifies the MUTATING-before-delete invariant value (PROP-013 asserts ordering, not the marker).

evidence.snippet: Proof Obligations table: no row references REQ-013 or NFR-002; PROP-030 asserts marker="DRY-RUN" only.

fix: Add PROPs for REQ-013 (install exits 0 in 4 repos + forbidden-branch commit fires hook), a metamorphic/property test for NFR-002 (random records with >=1 active signal must classify ACTIVE), and a PROP asserting the MUTATING marker is written+fsynced before the delete. Add beads for REQ-013 and NFR-002.
